item.title: Winter Showcase – Win Clip Studio Paint
item.description: The Showcase Competition is back with a winter vibe. Submit your Winter-themed artwork for a chance to be featured on 80 Level and win prizes from our partner Clip Studio Paint.

item.title: Creating Realistic Vintage Cassette Recorder with Substance 3D & UE5
item.description: Louise Wyke talked to us about the CTR-85 Recorder project, discussing modeling and texturing a realistic vintage cassette recorder with three skins using Maya, Substance 3D Painter, Marmoset Toolbag, and Unreal Engine.

item.title: See How You Can Create 3D Model of Old, Used Phone
item.description: Rohit Jangra showed the work behind the Vintage Intercom project, explained how he added a story to the prop with wear and little details, and talked about the texturing steps.

item.title: Designing a Miami Vice-Inspired Futuristic Police Officer
item.description: Julien Lafragette shared with us how he created a futuristic police officer, explaining how he designed the character, mixing the Miami Vice style and creating a storytelling that could exist in the GTA World.

item.title: How to Re-Imagine The Walking Dead's Clementine in The Last of Us World
item.description: Mehul Soni shared the workflow behind the Clementine fan art, detailing how he modeled the character by dividing it into sections and how he textured the clothes and weapons, intending to show a story.

item.title: Turning Post-Soviet Dacha Into Mech-Inspired Space
item.description: Sergey Vasnev spoke with us about his Dacha project, explaining how he challenged himself with a vibrant concept piece that transforms a post-Soviet country house into a mecha-style space.

item.title: Creating Adventurer's Outfit Inspired by The Last of Us in 3D
item.description: Creative Cave told us about how they made an outfit for a male adventurer inspired by The Last of Us, explaining the process of modeling wrinkles and adding details to make it more realistic.

item.title: How to Create Realistic Foliage Using ZBrush, SpeedTree, & Substance 3D
item.description: Anna Dalmau Forcano shared a breakdown of the Forest Foliage project, discussing creating realistic detailed foliage with ZBrush, Substance 3D Painter, SpeedTree, and Unreal Engine 5.7.
